name: Asarel
overview: Asarel is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Jehallelel. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, without additional narrative or descriptive notes. This positions him within the broader lineage of Judah as recorded in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Asarel is presented as a proper name without an explicit meaning or divine attribution in the biblical text. Therefore, it is recognized simply as a personal name recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:16 without further elaboration on its significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Asarel as the son of Jehallelel, establishing a direct father-son relationship. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented for Asarel in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Asarel's significance lies in his role within the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, which are important for tracing the lineage and heritage of God's people. While he does not have a detailed narrative, his inclusion in 1 Chronicles 4:16 contributes to the biblical emphasis on family lines and God's providential preservation of His chosen tribe.
